profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Guardian Life

positions.title: Technical Manager II
positions.locationName: 7 Hanover Square H4A, New York City, NY 10004
positions.description: Provide technical direction for the development, design, and systems integration for client engagement from definition phase through implementation.

positions.title: Technical Specialist III
positions.description:
In charge of maintaining the"Books and Records system" for Park Avenue Securities, which captures, stores, processes and reports the complete range of information necessary for PAS to operate it business, some of my responsibilities included:
.  
Translated business and technical requirements into well-engineered, tested, and deployed business application systems. This included the analysis, design, development, testing, installation, and maintenance of information systems and acting as interface with customers and other developers to determine the most efficient and cost-effective approach to meet business requirements. I was involved in Projects that utilize a variety of hardware and software technologies that include new code construction, modifications to existing modules, and/or package implementation. 

Provided leadership and unique insight in the analysis of customer business requirements that may cross multiple functional areas and/or multiple technical platforms, and have broad strategic implications of Park Avenue Securities.

Addressed the most complex design and troubleshooting problems in IT typically involving large, inter-dependent systems, new technologies, significant architectural issues, and broad business implications for Park Avenue Securities.

Ensured the transfer of their knowledge through on-the-job training, technical presentations, and on-going technical coaching.

Acted as a technical project lead for a project team. 

Know how to interpret logical data and process modeling in order to translate it into technical specifications

Maintained a network of peers in the field to improve ability to solve system problems and identify best practices.

Participated in buy/build analysis and feasibility reviews as well as in the development of RFIs, RFPs, and vendor reviews.

positions.title: Senior Technical Specialist,  Equity Licensing
positions.description: Responsible for maintenance and enhancement of the Equity Licensing System, a system developed to administer FINRA registration, state licensing and appointment of Guardian agents and outside broker-dealer registered representatives.  Duties included analysis, programming and implementation of new projects within the system.  Provided maintenance and development in both batch and on-line environments. Analyze user requirements to determine the best method of implementation and code and modify programs according to specifications.
